title: Headless TTW Take it Back! (MQ11, Broken Steel's version): from Sarah Lyons' briefing (stage 20) through Liberty Prime's march, Colonel Autumn and the purifier's code to Broken Steel's wake-up two weeks later (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Joins The American Dream's end (the MQ09 chain's last step): Sarah Lyons' 'need more time' line set MQ09 200 and Take it Back! (MQ11) 20, with SarahMoreTime 1. Given here; the player is at the Citadel with Sarah.

Stand-in for Rothchild starting Liberty Prime (his package after stage 25's EVP activates the launch control, whose script MQ11LaunchLibertyPrimeScript [observed] sets MQ11.PrimeActivate 1; no placed reference in this load order runs that script [observed], so the variable is set as that block would). MQ11's script then raises Prime and, after its hold timer, sets stage 30 (and MQ09 200 if not yet set).

On the way out of the Citadel the player crosses MQ11CitCraneTriggerRef (0x0A07E490, base MQ11CitCraneTrigger, script 0x0A07E491; TTW's version is OnTriggerEnter): at MQ11 30 it sets MQ01VargasREF's mq11vargastravel 1 and moves him (and MQ01SarahREF, mq11sarahtravel 2) to MQ11SarahExitCitadelMarker when they are not in the Wasteland, then re-evaluates their packages [observed: decompiled]. Only Vargas' script sets MQ11.LDSequenceStart, once he is within 700 of MQ11LDPrimeREFmarker at stage 30 [observed: SCPT 0x0A01ECB3]. The move to Prime below skips that crossing, so the trigger is entered here and Vargas given time to go.

actions.label: out of the Citadel: Vargas sent on

actions.text: Stand-in for Liberty Prime's march to Project Purity with the Pride (the AI: Prime's gate packages, the force-field pylons and the Enclave in the way). Prime's last gate package's end script [observed] sets MQ11LD.FinalGateFlag; the end gate's script then runs Prime's shutdown of the final force field. In the game the player goes to Prime and along with him until that package ends (the pilot follows the actor of a package step); headless the package's end stands in for the march.
Travel stand-in: through Project Purity's halls to the rotunda, where Colonel Autumn waits (stage 40 [observed] puts him at MQ11AutumnMarker). His greeting's begin script sets stage 50.
Stand-in for the fight in the rotunda: Autumn's two Tesla-armoured guards fall too (their script [observed] counts them into MQ11.AutumnDead).

actions.label: sarah: the Pride should be mopping up

actions.text: The control room by the purifier's airlock: the airlock panel's script [observed] has the intercom say Doctor Li's call once IntercomSayTo is 1.
Sarah answers Li at the intercom (her package after the line's EVP: a conversation with the intercom on MQ11SarahLiConversation, five lines, each counting MQ11.IntercomConv) [observed].

Headless gap [observed]: the conversation stops after Sarah's opening line; the intercom's six answers (MQ11SarahLiConversation, Run Immediately, each with a choice back to the same topic) are not said. Stand-in: the intercom's lines are said in their order (each begin script counts IntercomConv), forced because say_info speaks them to the player while their conditions name Sarah as the listener.

actions.label: milestone: MQ11 61, Sarah enters the code

actions.text: Stand-in for Sarah's walk through the airlock into the irradiated chamber (her airlock packages): she activates the purifier's control panel, whose script [observed] (Sarah as the action ref) starts the purifier and, 20 s on, ends the game: the ending slides (EndingBinks), then Broken Steel moves the player to the Citadel and sets DLC03BS1 0.
The player watches from the control room, by the panel (its script runs while its cell is loaded).

Broken Steel: the player wakes in the Citadel two weeks later (DLC03BS1 1, 2: Lyons' EVP). Elder Lyons' greeting; asking what now and offering help ends MQ11 [observed] (stage 200) and points to Rothchild (DLC03BS1 objective 10).
